Title: Public preview: Script-based deployment for SQL Server on Linux Azure VM
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
A new deployment experience for SQL Server on Linux Azure Virtual Machines (VMs) replaces legacy marketplace images with automated script-based provisioning. This release provides greater flexibility, simplified management, and improved customization. You can deploy a standard Linux VM, configure SQL Server, and automatically install and register SQL Server through an integrated workflow. 

Learn more.
